growth.name: Growth bot
growth.tagline: Buys the 20 biggest 12-month winners and re-picks every quarter. Aims for higher returns and accepts bigger drops.
growth.description: The bot picks from the Nifty MidSmallcap 400 index. From the stocks in an uptrend it holds the 20 with the biggest 12-month rise. Stocks are re-picked quarterly. Idle cash is assumed to earn 6% a year, as in a liquid fund. 0.2% cost per trade. Prices from Yahoo Finance (may be delayed ~15 min).

steady.name: Steady bot
steady.tagline: Buys 20 calm, steadily rising stocks and holds back cash when the market gets rough. Aims for smoother returns and accepts lower gains.
steady.description: The bot picks from the Nifty MidSmallcap 400 index. From the stocks in an uptrend it holds the 20 calmest stocks among the top third by 6-month rise. Stocks are re-picked monthly. At most 4 stocks may come from one industry. It invests less when the market is unusually jumpy (checked weekly). Idle cash is assumed to earn 6% a year, as in a liquid fund. 0.2% cost per trade. Prices from Yahoo Finance (may be delayed ~15 min).
